questions.stem: What is the correct balanced equation for the combustion of propane (C₃H₈)?
questions.explanation: Balancing: 3 C atoms need 3CO₂, 8 H atoms need 4H₂O. Oxygen on the right: (3 × 2) + 4 = 10 oxygen atoms, so we need 5O₂ on the left. Check: C: 3 = 3, H: 8 = 8, O: 10 = 10. The equation is balanced.

questions.stem: When balancing a chemical equation, which of the following should you change?

options.text: The subscripts (small numbers) in the chemical formulas
The coefficients (big numbers) in front of the formulas
The chemical symbols of the elements

questions.explanation: When balancing equations, you must only change the coefficients (the large numbers in front of formulas). Changing subscripts would change the chemical formula and create a different substance entirely. The formulas of reactants and products must remain unchanged.
